image_description: A close-up shot of a doll's head and upper torso. The doll has fair skin, blue eyes, and is wearing a bright pink knitted hooded garment. On its head is a voluminous, synthetic-looking blue wig with a straight fringe (bangs) covering the forehead. The wig appears to be made of shiny, plastic-like fibers. The background is dark and indistinct.

Instead of distinct hair strands, the texture looks like melted plastic or low-resolution noise smearing, particularly in the upper voluminous sections. This is a common AI artifact when rendering fine, repetitive structures like hair.

The facial features, specifically the mouth and chin, appear distorted and fused. The lips lack clear definition and seem to merge into the surrounding skin/pink fabric. The geometry of the lower face is nonsensical.
